rows.text: The Ministry of Human Resource Development's resolution F. No. 38-1/95-C & M of 14 October 1996, notifying the composition of the National Committee for the commemoration of the 50th Anniversary of India's Independence, lists under the heading 'Presidents of all Major National Political Parties' '111. Shri Laloo Prasad Yadav, Janata Dal'.
